note: Ellsworth County KS has no queryable zoning district service found. The City of Ellsworth (the county's main city) publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (docview 30255); the city zoning page covers city limits only. ArcGIS searches for Ellsworth zoning found no county or city zoning layer; the KS DASC/ORKA catalog lists zoning only for Shawnee County. Floodplain viewer exists but is not zoning.
